items.title: Haywood Hillyer Interview, 1958-05-14
items.q: Harris Duchamp, Edmond, Myra Mendel, and all that crowd. I've never been too active with them... But I often covered their meetings to take pictures of them.

ctx.x: Listen, you've mentioned over the years of popular form of entertainment, something to dance to, right? Have you noticed any interest, any increase in interest in the art form?

Oh, yes, I think so. I mean, all over America and in England too. Oh, I'm talking about in New Orleans. In New Orleans, I think the jazz club here is a very enthusiastic group. Harris Duchamp, Edmond, Myra Mendel, and all that crowd. I've never been too active with them because I've been away of Greybill since it was organized and was working on the paper. But I often covered their meetings to take pictures of them. And I thought their interest was very high and has increased all these years.
Would you say that represented a majority of New Orleans people that were interested in jazz?
